Landing.invitacion: Leave us a review on Google
Landing.aviso: This will take you to Google to write your review
Landing.sinEnlace: This venue hasn't set up its review link yet.
Landing.cierre: Thank you for being part of our experience

inactiva.detalle: The bracelet exists but is switched off right now, so there's nowhere for it to take you.

meta.titulo: Toqia · Your business, one tap away
meta.descripcion: NFC bands, cards and plaques so your customers reach your menu, your offers and your Google reviews with a single tap.

Sitio.mensajeWhatsapp: Hi, I'd like to know more about Toqia for my business.

hero.texto: Connect your customers with what matters most about your business — fast, modern and hassle-free.
hero.altPulsera: Black Toqia NFC band, with the contactless symbol on the central disc.

1.texto: Your customer holds their phone near your NFC band, card or stand.

2.texto: Your own page opens right away — no app to install.

3.texto: They browse your menu, prices, services and offers, or leave a review.

visibilidad.texto: More reviews and more word of mouth.

tiempo.texto: Information that's always up to date.

experiencia.texto: Your customers reach everything quickly and easily.

imagen.texto: Modern technology that lifts your brand.

cierre.titulo: Ready to take your business<salto></salto>to the <destacado>next level</destacado>?

pie.texto: One tap and done. NFC bands, cards and plaques that connect your customers with what matters about your business.

Stats.fechasHoraLocal: dates are shown in local time.
Stats.subtituloEvolucion: How many scanned and how many reached Google
Stats.sinCamareros: No staff members have assigned wristbands yet.
Stats.sinCamarerosSistema: No wristband is assigned to a staff member yet.
Stats.sinEscaneosPeriodo: No scans recorded in this period yet.
Stats.elegirRangoHint: Select both dates to apply the range.
Stats.viendoComoAdmin: You are viewing the dashboard of {nombre} as an administrator. Changes made here affect the business.

Camareros.subtitulo: Deactivating a staff member does not delete their scans: history is kept.
Camareros.sinCamareros: No staff members added yet. Create one and assign wristbands from the Wristbands section.
Camareros.nuevoCamareroDesc: You can assign a bracelet to them later from the Bracelets section.
Camareros.subtituloAdmin: Each business manages them from its own panel. Here you can see them all.
Camareros.sinCamarerosAdmin: No business has added staff members yet.
Camareros.borrarCamareroDesc: Their bracelets are not deleted: they're left unassigned. The scan history is kept. This cannot be undone.

Pulseras.subtitulo: Assign each wristband to a staff member so their scans enter the ranking.
Pulseras.sinPulseras: No wristbands loaded yet. The Toqia team adds them.
Pulseras.subtituloAdmin: The URL written to the chip never changes. What changes is the page it leads to.
Pulseras.sinPulserasFiltro: No bracelets match this filter. Use “Bulk create” to generate a whole batch.
Pulseras.nuevaDesc: The code is the one written to the chip and cannot be repeated anywhere in the system.
Pulseras.generarLoteDesc: Codes that already exist are skipped.
Pulseras.resumenLote: {creadas} bracelets created. {salteadas} were skipped because they already existed: {codigos}
Pulseras.editarDesc: Changing the code means the chip has to be written again.
Pulseras.destinoDirectoHint: If you fill this in, the bracelet skips the venue page and goes straight here. The scan is still recorded.
Pulseras.borrarPulseraDesc: This also deletes its {n, plural, one {# scan} other {# scans}}. This cannot be undone. If you only want to turn it off, use the power button.

CartaAdmin.subtituloVacia: Add your catalogue and customers will see it when scanning.
CartaAdmin.sinLocales: No venues loaded yet. The Toqia team adds them.
CartaAdmin.imagenCartaHint: It appears at the very top of the catalogue the customer sees. It is shown in landscape; a horizontal photo of the venue or of a standout product works well.
CartaAdmin.guardadoExito: Saved. The changes are already live on your page.
CartaAdmin.cartaVacia: Your catalogue is empty. Start by creating a category, for example “Starters”.
CartaAdmin.borrarCategoriaDesc: Its {n, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} will be deleted too. This cannot be undone. If you only want to take it off the catalogue, use the eye to hide it.
CartaAdmin.borrarPlatoDesc: This cannot be undone. If it just sold out today, better mark it as sold out with the eye: it stays visible and you can bring it back tomorrow.
CartaAdmin.fotoPlatoHint: It shows as a square next to the name. A photo of the product on its own, well lit, works better than one of the whole counter.
CartaAdmin.iconoElegido: It shows next to the name in the catalogue. Tap it again to remove it.
CartaAdmin.iconoVacio: Without an icon, the category shows with its name only.

Configuracion.subtitulo: This is what customers see when tapping their phone on a wristband.
Configuracion.sinLocales: No venues loaded yet. The Toqia team adds them.
Configuracion.guardadoExito: Saved. The changes are already live on your page.
Configuracion.secIdentidadDesc: The name and images your venue introduces itself with.
Configuracion.secTextosDesc: What the customer reads. If you leave them empty we use ours.
Configuracion.secResenasDesc: The main button on the page.
Configuracion.secContactoDesc: Every field you fill in adds its button; empty ones do not show.
Configuracion.secCartaDesc: What your page's button is called and what opens when it is tapped.
Configuracion.nombreVisibleHint: If you leave it empty the venue name is used.
Configuracion.logoHint: A PNG with a transparent background looks better over the cover.
Configuracion.coverHint: It goes behind the logo, at the very top. A photo of the dining room works well: it is darkened automatically so the logo stays readable.
Configuracion.welcomeKickerHint: If you leave it empty we use “Thanks for visiting us”.
Configuracion.closingHint: It goes with the farewell message, at the very bottom.
Configuracion.googleReviewUrlHint: This is the main button on the page. Without it, the customer has nowhere to leave the review.
Configuracion.whatsappPhoneHint: With country code, no + and no spaces.
Configuracion.phoneHint: This is the one behind the “Call” button. It can be different from the WhatsApp number.
Configuracion.reservationUrlHint: If you leave it empty, “Book” opens WhatsApp with the message “Hi, I'd like to make a booking” already written. Fill it in only if you use a booking platform.
Configuracion.currencyHint: The symbol shown with prices: €, $, US$…
Configuracion.mapsUrlHint: Optional. If you leave it empty but filled in the address, the button searches for that address on Maps.
Configuracion.textoBotonCartaHint: Use whatever fits your business: “Price list”, “Catalogue”, “See services”. If you leave it empty it says <defecto>View menu</defecto>. Up to 40 characters, but don't go past two or three words: the button is small and the text wraps.
Configuracion.toqiaDetalle: The one you fill in under “My catalogue”, with categories, prices and photos. Changes show instantly and nothing has to be uploaded.
Configuracion.pdfDetalle: Your own file. Every time prices change the PDF has to be uploaded again.
Configuracion.pdfArchivoHint: A PDF. It opens in a new tab when the customer taps “{nombre}”.
Configuracion.welcomeTitlePlaceholder: Your opinion helps us keep improving
Configuracion.closingMessagePlaceholder: Thanks for being part of our experience
Configuracion.avisoSinPlatos: You haven't added any dishes yet: until you do, the “{boton}” button will not show on your page.
Configuracion.avisoSinPdf: Upload the file below, or the “{boton}” button will not show.

Archivos.seVaAQuitar: It will be removed when you save.

Login.accesoRestringido: Restricted access. There is no public sign-up.
Login.errorRed: Could not reach the server. Check that it is running and try again.
Login.errorInesperado: Something unexpected went wrong while signing in. Please try again.
Login.errorSinCuenta: Your user has no business assigned. Get in touch and we'll set it up.
Login.bloqueo: Too many failed attempts. You'll be able to try again in <n>{restante}</n> {restante, plural, one {second} other {seconds}}.

Errores.campoLargoConCuenta: {campo} cannot be longer than {tope} characters (it has {tiene}).
Errores.campoUrlIncompleta: {campo} has to be a full URL, including https://
Errores.campoUrlProtocolo: {campo} can only be http or https.
Errores.codigoLargo: The code cannot be longer than 50 characters.
Errores.codigoFormato: The code only allows letters, numbers, dots, hyphens and underscores.
Errores.slugLargo: The slug cannot be longer than 100 characters.
Errores.slugFormato: The slug only allows lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (e.g. la-parrilla-centro).
Errores.destinoLargo: The destination cannot be longer than 2048 characters.
Errores.destinoIncompleto: The destination has to be a full URL, including https://
Errores.destinoProtocolo: The destination can only be http or https.
Errores.telefonoDigitos: The phone number has to be between 8 and 15 digits, with country code (e.g. 5491133334444).
Errores.estadoSuscripcion: That subscription status is not valid.
Errores.emailLargo: The email cannot be longer than 255 characters.
Errores.emailFormato: That email is not a valid address.
Errores.passwordCorta: The password has to be at least 8 characters.
Errores.passwordLarga: The password cannot be longer than 128 characters.
Errores.faltanMigraciones: Database migrations are pending: go to the admin panel, Maintenance section, and apply the pending changes.
Errores.campoDemasiadoLargo: One of the fields has more text than fits.
Errores.caracterNoSoportado: The database does not accept one of the characters typed: the table is not utf8mb4.
Errores.localNoExiste: The chosen venue does not exist.
Errores.localNoValido: The chosen venue is not valid.
Errores.localDeOtroDistribuidor: That venue does not belong to any of your businesses.
Errores.faltaIdCamarero: The staff member identifier is missing.
Errores.camareroNoExiste: That staff member no longer exists.
Errores.camareroElegidoNoExiste: The chosen staff member does not exist.
Errores.camareroDeOtroLocal: That staff member belongs to another venue.
Errores.pulseraSinLocalConCamarero: A bracelet with no venue cannot have a staff member assigned.
Errores.cuentaElegidaNoExiste: The chosen account does not exist.
Errores.distribuidorNoExiste: The chosen distributor does not exist.
Errores.categoriaElegidaNoExiste: The chosen category does not exist.
Errores.nombreLargo120: The name cannot be longer than 120 characters.
Errores.nombreLargo160: The name cannot be longer than 160 characters.
Errores.precioNoPositivo: The price has to be a positive number.
Errores.telefonoCorto: The contact phone number is too short.
Errores.monedaLarga: The currency symbol cannot be longer than 8 characters.
Errores.fechaVencimientoInvalida: That expiry date is not valid.
Errores.destinoNoValido: The chosen destination is not valid.
Errores.tipoDispositivoNoValido: That device type is not valid.
Errores.prefijoFormato: The prefix only allows letters, numbers, dots, hyphens and underscores.
Errores.cantidadMinima: The quantity has to be at least 1.
Errores.inicioNegativo: The starting number cannot be negative.
Errores.rellenoRango: Padding has to be between 0 and 10.
Errores.codigosYaExisten: Every code in that range already exists.
Errores.codigoGeneradoLargo: The generated code “{code}” is longer than 50 characters.
Errores.cuentaConEseSlug: An account with the slug “{slug}” already exists.
Errores.otraCuentaConEseSlug: Another account with the slug “{slug}” already exists.
Errores.localConEseSlug: A venue with the slug “{slug}” already exists.
Errores.otroLocalConEseSlug: Another venue with the slug “{slug}” already exists.
Errores.pulseraConEseCodigo: A bracelet with the code {code} already exists.
Errores.otraPulseraConEseCodigo: Another bracelet with the code {code} already exists.
Errores.usuarioSinCuenta: A business user needs an account assigned.
Errores.emailYaUsado: A user with that email already exists.
Errores.otroEmailYaUsado: Another user with that email already exists.
Errores.noPodesCambiarteElRol: You cannot change your own role. Ask another admin to do it.
Errores.ultimoAdmin: This is the only admin left: if you remove the role, nobody can get into the administration.
Errores.sinCredenciales: The details were saved, but that user has no credentials on file, so the password could not be set.
Errores.nombreSinDireccionWeb: That name cannot be turned into a valid web address.
Errores.empresaParecida: A business with a similar name already exists (“{slug}”). Try another one.
Errores.localParecido: A venue with a similar name already exists (“{slug}”). Try another one.
Errores.noSePudoDarDeAlta: The business could not be created. Please try again.
Errores.archivoPesado: {campo}: the file is {peso} and the limit is {maximo}.
Errores.archivoNoPdf: {campo}: the file is not a valid PDF.
Errores.archivoNoImagen: {campo}: the file is not a valid image (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF and AVIF are accepted).
Errores.archivoEnumFaltante: {campo}: the database does not accept this file type yet. The pending migrations have to be applied from Maintenance, in the admin panel.
Errores.archivoNoGuardado: {campo}: the file could not be saved. Try a lighter one.
Errores.noSePudoCrearCamarero: Could not create the staff member
Errores.noSePudoGuardarCamarero: Could not save the staff member
Errores.noSePudoCambiarEstadoCamarero: Could not change the staff member's status
Errores.noSePudoAsignarCamarero: Could not assign the staff member
Errores.noSePudoCambiarEstadoCategoria: Could not change the category's status
Errores.noSePudoCambiarEstadoCuenta: Could not change the account's status
Errores.noSePudoCambiarEstadoLocal: Could not change the venue's status
Errores.noSePudoCambiarEstadoPulsera: Could not change the bracelet's status
Errores.confirmacionExacta: To confirm you have to type exactly “{frase}”.
Errores.csvFallido: The CSV could not be generated. Check the logs.
Errores.noPodesBorrarteVos: You can't delete your own user. Ask another admin to do it.
Errores.ultimoAdminNoSeBorra: It's the only admin left: it can't be deleted. Create another admin first.

Mantenimiento.subtitulo: Bring the database schema up to date and empty it to start with real data.
Mantenimiento.pendientes: {n, plural, one {# pending change} other {# pending changes}}
Mantenimiento.sincronizada: Nothing is missing: the code and the database are in sync.
Mantenimiento.faltanCambios: While a change is missing, the pages that use those columns will fail with a server error.
Mantenimiento.vaciarDesc: It deletes accounts, venues, bracelets, staff, scans, menus and uploaded files, and every user but yours (<email></email>). There is no way to undo it: if you want to keep anything, export it first from Scans.
Mantenimiento.aplicados: Done: {n, plural, one {# change applied} other {# changes applied}}.
Mantenimiento.yaAlDia: The database was already up to date: there was nothing to apply.
Mantenimiento.baseVaciada: Database emptied: {filas} row(s) deleted. Only {email} is left.
Mantenimiento.vaciarLaBaseDesc: {filas} row(s) will go, across accounts, venues, bracelets, staff, scans, menus, uploaded files and the other users. This cannot be undone.
Mantenimiento.tuUsuarioSeConserva: Your user <email></email> is kept, with your session open.
Mantenimiento.traduccionDesc: Dish names, descriptions and welcome texts are translated automatically whenever a venue saves from its panel. This is for what was already there before: it goes through the database and translates whatever is missing. Running it twice costs nothing, because anything already translated is not requested again.
Mantenimiento.noSeTradujo: Nothing was translated: automatic translation is turned off.
Mantenimiento.sinTraductorDesc: Automatic translation is turned off in the code (see src/lib/traduccion/proveedor.ts). Every text is shown exactly as the venue wrote it: nothing breaks, but the menu is not translated.
Mantenimiento.traducidas: Done: {n, plural, one {# text translated} other {# texts translated}}.
Mantenimiento.nadaQueTraducir: There was nothing pending: all the content is already translated.

VistaPrevia.aviso: Preview · clicks on this screen are not recorded

Usuarios.subtitulo: System access. There is no public sign-up: every user is created here.
Usuarios.aviso: A user with the business role and no account assigned can see nothing: if you spot a row like that, edit it and assign the account.
Usuarios.passwordHintEditar: If you change it, open sessions stay active until they expire.
Usuarios.passwordHintAlta: At least 8 characters. Send it to the user through a safe channel and ask them to change it.
Usuarios.nuevoDesc: There is no public sign-up: every account is created from here.
Usuarios.avisoEsVos: This is your own user. You can change your details, but not your role: removing your admin role would lock you out of the administration.
Usuarios.noPodesBorrarte: You can't delete your own user.

Locales.subtitulo: Each venue has its own public page, its own bracelets and its own staff.
Locales.resenaFaltaHint: The landing page does not show the review button
Locales.nuevoDesc: The rest of the public page details are filled in by the business itself from its panel.
Locales.borrarLocalDesc: This also deletes its {pulseras, plural, one {# bracelet} other {# bracelets}}, staff, categories and dishes, along with all its scans. This cannot be undone.

Cuentas.subtitulo: Each account groups one client's venues. Closing one cuts off all of its bracelets.
Cuentas.avisoElegir: To enter a business's panel, pick which one with the <icono></icono> button on its row. You'll be able to set up its page and fill in its menu as if you were them.
Cuentas.nuevaDesc: An account groups the venues of a single client. You add the venues afterwards.
Cuentas.editarDesc: Cancelling the subscription cuts off the redirect for all of its bracelets.
Cuentas.darDeBajaHint: Close it (cuts off all of its bracelets)
Cuentas.rubroAyuda: It is what the business sees in its panel instead of the word “Business”. If you leave it empty, “Business” is shown.
Cuentas.borrarCuentaDesc: This also deletes its {locales, plural, one {# location} other {# locations}} and {pulseras, plural, one {# bracelet} other {# bracelets}}, along with all its scans, staff and panel users. This cannot be undone.

Distribuidor.sinNada: You have no accounts assigned and no bracelets delivered yet. Once Toqia delivers a batch you'll be able to create your first business from <enlace>Businesses</enlace>.
Distribuidor.subtituloRestaurantes: The ones you created. Toqia handles the subscription status.
Distribuidor.sinRestaurantes: You haven't created any business yet. “New business” creates the account, its venue and the panel access in one go.
Distribuidor.nuevoRestauranteDesc: It creates the account, its first venue and the panel access. The business fills in the rest.
Distribuidor.nombrePersonaPlaceholder: If you leave it empty the business name is used
Distribuidor.enlaceResenasHint: It is the one thing the bracelets need to be useful. If you don't have it now, the business can add it later from its panel.
Distribuidor.credencialesDesc: Pass these details on to the business. The password cannot be seen again: if it is lost, a new one has to be generated.
Distribuidor.subtituloPulseras: The ones Toqia delivered to you. Choose which venue each one goes to.
Distribuidor.sinPulserasEntregadas: Toqia hasn't delivered any bracelets yet. When it does, they show up here for you to hand out among your businesses.
Distribuidor.rubroAyuda: It is what the business sees in its panel instead of the word “Business”. If you leave it empty, “Business” is shown.
Distribuidor.borrarEmpresaDesc: This also deletes its {locales, plural, one {# location} other {# locations}} and {pulseras, plural, one {# bracelet} other {# bracelets}}, along with all its scans and staff. This cannot be undone.
